title: Strength Build Basics
content: Strength builds usually target 27 strength when two-handing or 40 strength for one-handed scaling. Endurance matters because heavy weapons and poise armor compete for equipment load. Good lighter alternatives include Reinforced Club, Battle Axe, Claymore, and Man-Serpent Greatsword.

title: Dexterity Build Basics
content: Dexterity builds value low weight, fast recovery, bleed, and counter damage. Uchigatana, Great Scythe, Balder Side Sword, and Estoc support fast roll loadouts and benefit from sharp upgrade paths.

title: Quality Build Basics
content: Quality builds invest in both strength and dexterity, usually around 27/40 or 40/40 depending on level. Claymore, Longsword, and Black Knight Sword are strong examples because their movesets cover many matchups.

title: Caster Hybrid Notes
content: Pyromancy is a low-stat splash option because damage comes from upgrading the flame. Faith and sorcery builds need attunement slots, a catalyst or talisman, and rings that boost spell damage or preserve survivability.

title: Equip Load and Roll Breakpoints
content: Dark Souls 1 builds are often defined by roll breakpoints. Havel's Ring and Ring of Favor and Protection create room for heavier gear. Light armor with Wolf Ring or Dark Wood Grain Ring supports mobility without fully abandoning poise.

title: Build Archetype Language
content: When players ask for a tank build, they usually mean high vitality, endurance, poise, blocking or trading hits, and often strength weapons. When they ask for a high damage or glass cannon build, ask whether they want heavy melee damage, fast bleed pressure, or ranged sorcery damage unless they already gave a clear style. Wizard, mage, dark wizard, and intelligence usually refer to sorcery, not pyromancy. Ninja usually means a light dexterity build with fast roll pressure, bleed, and Shadow Set-style armor.

title: Useful Early Pickups
content: Several strong build items can be routed early: Zweihander from the Firelink graveyard, Estoc from the path toward New Londo, Grass Crest Shield from Darkroot Basin, Crimson Set from Blighttown, and Great Scythe from The Catacombs.
